bannerBody: Just {{count}} day left to confirm you’re 18+ and keep matching.
bannerBody_other: You have {{count}} days to confirm you’re 18+ and keep matching.
gateBody: To keep PassorMatch safe, we just need a quick selfie to confirm you’re 18 or over. It only takes a few seconds.
introBody: A quick selfie is all we need. No ID, no forms — and your photo is deleted the moment we’re done.
captureBody: Checking that you’re a real person — your photo is never stored.
passedBody: Your age is confirmed. You now have full access to PassorMatch.
challengeBody: We couldn't confirm your age from the selfie alone. Retry in better light.
failedBody: PassorMatch is only for adults 18 and over. If you believe this is a mistake, our team is happy to help.
errorStart: Something went wrong starting the check. Please try again.
errorSubmit: We couldn’t read your result. Please try again.
errorCapture: The camera check didn’t finish. Let’s try again.
verifiedBadgeTitle: This member has verified they are 18 or over
errorCameraDenied: We need camera access for the age check. Please enable it in your settings and try again.
introBullet3: Your photo is deleted right after
challengeExhaustedBody: We couldn’t quite confirm your age from that selfie. A well-lit retry usually does the trick.
challengeTip1: Find good lighting — face the light, not a window behind you
challengeTip2: Take off glasses or a mask, and hold your phone steady
retryHintBorderline: We couldn’t clearly confirm your age. Move to brighter light, face the camera straight on, and keep your whole face in view.
retryHintFace: We couldn’t get a clear read of your face. Make sure only your face is in the frame, centered and well-lit.
retryHintLiveness: We couldn’t confirm a live person. Hold your phone steady and follow the on-screen prompts.
retryHintCapture: The camera check didn’t finish. Keep your face in the oval until it completes.
retryHintGeneric: Let’s try once more — face the camera in good, even lighting and hold still.
lvMoveFace: Move your face in front of the camera
lvTooBright: It’s a bit too bright — try softer light
lvTooDark: It’s a bit too dark — find brighter light
lvCantIdentify: Face the camera so we can see you clearly
photoVerifiedBadgeTitle: This member completed a live selfie check
